WITH g AS (
  SELECT team_id, game_id, game_date, team_won
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_team_game_facts"
  WHERE season = 2012
    AND CAST(game_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '2%'
),
r AS (
  SELECT team_id, game_id, game_date, team_won,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY game_date, game_id)
    - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id, team_won ORDER BY game_date, game_id) AS grp
  FROM g
),
s AS (
  SELECT team_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_length,
    MIN(game_date) AS streak_start_date, MAX(game_date) AS streak_end_date
  FROM r
  WHERE team_won
  GROUP BY team_id, grp
)
SELECT team_id, streak_length, streak_start_date, streak_end_date
FROM s
WHERE streak_length = (SELECT MAX(streak_length) FROM s)
ORDER BY team_id
LIMIT 501
